results.name: datum_chain_for_each_invoke
results.evidence: Walks a two-level linked list built from datum tables DAT_0087a464 then DAT_0087a468 (classic datum_get shape: table+0x34, +8+idx*0xc) and calls FUN_00561b80(param_1,param_2) once per linked node until the chain hits -1.
results.summary: Generic linked-list walker over a pair of datum tables that invokes a two-argument callback for every linked entry.

results.name: datum_chain_set_object_flag
results.evidence: Same DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 chain traversal as FUN_00561cb0, but instead of a callback it sets or clears bit 0x00800000 of the dword at (linked object)+0x204 depending on the char argument param_1.
results.summary: Walks the same linked-list chain as FUN_00561cb0 and sets or clears an object flag bit on every entry found.

results.name: datum_chain_for_each_call
results.evidence: Same chain-walk structure again, this time calling FUN_005702a0(node_index,param_3) for every linked node while tracking a bool accumulator that the function never actually returns (void).
results.summary: Iterates the same datum-table linked list, invoking an unresolved helper for every linked node.

results.name: unit_current_weapon_is_type
results.evidence: Reads the unit's current-weapon slot (unit+0x2f2, a pattern reused consistently across this file) and its weapon-object-index array (unit+0x2f8+slot*4), then compares that weapon object's own type-tag dword (first field of any object struct) against unaff_EDI.
results.summary: Checks whether a unit's currently active weapon object matches a given object-type index, returning the result in AL.

results.name: unit_apply_scale_change
results.evidence: Sets object+0x38 from a positive float argument; when a bit of the second argument is set and the unit's animation-state byte (0x2a3, the same field driven throughout this file) equals 0x19, the function clears several counters (0x31e, 0xc6), OR's flag bits (0x106, 0x81), stamps the current tick into offset 0x107 from DAT_006f1d6c+0xc, and calls object_recalculate_bounding_radius_recursive.
results.summary: Updates a unit's size-related field and, on a specific animation-state/flag combination, resets related timers and recomputes the object's bounding radius.

results.name: unit_is_look_target_valid
results.evidence: Returns false only when unit+0x218 is set and (unit+0x11c, the generic object.parent_object_index field, is -1 or unit+0x2f0 (short, adjacent to the current-weapon-index field 0x2f2) is -1); gates a head/aim update call (FUN_005697a0) inside FUN_005625b0.
results.summary: Boolean gate combining several unit fields, used before performing a head-look/aim update.

results.name: unit_update_look_and_animation
results.evidence: Large (4765-byte) per-unit tick routine referencing the string "stand"; updates aim/head-look cones via vector3d_random_point_in_cone and FUN_00564ae0, reads object_get_orientation, gates on unit-state helpers FUN_00565c60/FUN_00562570, decrements shield/timer-like fields (0xba, 0xd0, 0xd1, 0xd2), and eventually calls FUN_00570720/FUN_0056ec60 based on a countdown at offset 0x28b.
results.summary: Per-tick update of a unit's aiming/head-look direction cones, several countdown timers, and animation-state triggers.

results.name: unit_apply_control_block
results.evidence: Given a unit index (via in_EAX) and a source block (in_EDX), optionally bulk-copies a 0x40-byte region into unit+0x478 when DAT_00719720==2, then unconditionally copies ~15 fields from the source block into fixed unit offsets (0x278-0x28c, 0x2f4, 0x31d, 0x321, 0x208, 0x224-0x25c, 0x2a6) and finally sets unit+0x4bc/0x4b8 from param_1 -- the shape of a struct-to-struct field copy applying externally supplied unit control/definition data.
results.summary: Copies a block of externally supplied fields into a unit's control-state structure, plus an owner-object index.

results.name: unit_set_desired_aim_velocity
results.evidence: Trivial setter: writes param_1 and param_2 directly into unit+0x210 and unit+0x214, a pair of dwords adjacent to other control-input fields touched by FUN_005639f0.
results.summary: Stores two caller-supplied values into a unit's control-input fields at offsets 0x210/0x214.

results.name: unit_update_aiming_overlay_angles
results.evidence: Uses object_get_orientation plus matrix4x3_inverse_transform_normal and fpatan (atan2) calls to derive pitch/yaw angles from a transformed aim vector, then feeds them into FUN_004d4f90/FUN_004d53f0/FUN_004d51a0/FUN_004d5c00 which look like per-node animation-overlay weight setters (matrix4x3/object callee prefixes).
results.summary: Computes the unit's current aiming pitch/yaw and drives several animation-overlay blend-weight setters from them.

results.name: unit_find_weapon_marker_transform
results.evidence: Iterates a unit-type marker/model tag block (count at +0xc, 100-byte stride at +0x10) matching by name via __stricmp against the weapon's marker name, then a nested weapon-permutation block, computes a transform via matrix4x3_from_quaternion/matrix4x3_multiply, and builds a second lookup name by appending a fixed suffix before calling FUN_004f6080 again.
results.summary: Resolves a named marker on a unit's currently referenced weapon, computing its transform and a secondary derived-name marker lookup.

results.name: unit_get_weapon_marker_indices
results.evidence: Uses the unit's grenade/weapon-type byte (0xa8) to index a marker-name reflexive at stride 0xbc, selects a slot (0x27..0x2a) based on the in_AL flag, calls FUN_004d4850 (a marker-transform getter), and outputs two shorts read from the found marker record (offsets 0x22 and 0x34).
results.summary: Looks up a weapon/grenade marker record and outputs two indices (likely node/permutation) from it via output parameters.

results.name: unit_get_animation_frames_remaining
results.evidence: Reads the unit's current animation frame-count field via its marker table (short at +0xd0 indexing a per-marker frame-count array at tag+0x78, field +0x22) and subtracts the elapsed-frame counter at unit+0xd2, while also writing the unit's animation-state byte (0x2a3) out through *param_1.
results.summary: Returns how many frames remain in the unit's current animation and outputs its current animation-state byte.

results.name: real_motion_ramp_solve
results.evidence: Clean __cdecl-looking signature (5 float/pointer args, no leftover register variables) that recursively calls itself with negated inputs, solving a quadratic for a bounded accel/cruise/decel motion profile and writing a ~32-byte multi-phase result structure into param_5.
results.prototype: void __cdecl real_motion_ramp_solve(float param_1, float param_2, float param_3, float param_4, char *param_5)
results.summary: Solves a bounded acceleration/velocity motion ramp and writes the resulting multi-phase profile into the output structure.

results.name: motion_profile_merge_greatest
results.evidence: Consumes two motion-profile-shaped structures (in_ECX, in_EDX, same field layout as real_motion_ramp_solve's output), compares their totals, and clips/merges them using a quadratic (SQRT) computation.
results.summary: Selects and blends between two previously computed motion-ramp profiles, picking whichever has the larger magnitude.

results.name: motion_profile_evaluate
results.evidence: Given a motion-profile structure (in_ECX) with three phase segments (offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x1c matching real_motion_ramp_solve's output layout) and a distance/time budget (param_1), integrates through each phase and outputs position (param_3) and rate (param_5).
results.summary: Evaluates a previously solved motion-ramp profile at a given distance/time, returning interpolated position and rate.

results.name: vector3d_turn_toward_constrained
results.evidence: Computes spherical yaw/pitch (fpatan) for a current and desired direction, clamps them against a 4-float min/max range (param_3), and uses real_motion_ramp_solve/motion_profile_merge_greatest/motion_profile_evaluate plus vector3d_rotate_about_axis to turn a vector toward the target at a bounded rate; called from FUN_005625b0 for the unit's look/aim cones.
results.summary: Rotates a direction vector toward a desired direction at a bounded angular rate within given yaw/pitch limits.

results.name: vector3d_compute_clamped_cross_product
results.evidence: Computes a 3-component cross product into an output vector, normalizes it, clamps its magnitude against an input maximum (in_stack_000000a4), and optionally re-expresses it in local space via matrix4x3_transform_normal; no health/vitality field is read or written anywhere, so the existing name 'unit_scripting_set_current_vitality' does not match the code.
results.summary: Computes and clamps a cross-product vector, optionally transforming it into local space -- a generic vector-math helper, not a vitality/health setter.

results.name: unit_seat_index_is_valid
results.evidence: Range-checks in_DX against the unit-type's seat count (tag+0x2e4) and either short-circuits true when unit+0xb4==1 or otherwise delegates to FUN_005651e0(seat_offset,0,0), matching a seat-existence test.
results.summary: Tests whether a given seat index is valid for a unit's vehicle/type, deferring to the seat/weapon-label lookup routine.

results.name: unit_set_or_test_seat_and_weapon_label
results.evidence: Iterates the unit-type tag's seats block (100-byte stride, count at +0xc) matching param_1 by name via __stricmp, then iterates each seat's weapon-label sub-block (0x3c stride) matching param_2 or the literal string "unarmed", and on a match sets unit fields 0x2a1/0x2a2/0x2a7 and a bit in unit+0xa6 -- matches the naming hint 'unit_set_or_test_seat_and_weapon_label' among the four cea-pdb candidates listed for this address.
results.summary: Finds a matching seat/weapon-label pair on a unit and, when found, records the corresponding seat and weapon indices on it.

results.name: unit_update_animation_state_machine
results.evidence: Central switch over the unit's animation-state byte (0x2a3) driving state-specific behavior per case (0x19 vehicle-exit checks, 0x1a driver hand-off via FUN_0056ab30, 0x1b applies a transformed position offset via FUN_0056c640), and calls unit_set_or_test_seat_and_weapon_label and FUN_0056dfd0/FUN_0056ec10 to progress the state.
results.summary: Per-tick dispatcher that advances a unit's current special-move/seat-transition animation state and applies its side effects.

results.name: vector3d_project_point_onto_plane
results.evidence: Optionally fetches a stored plane (unaff_EBX, matching the 3-float fields also read/written by FUN_005696f0), then projects the point in in_EAX onto that plane using a dot-product/normal formula, and separately fetches an origin via FUN_004f6aa0.
results.summary: Projects a 3D point onto a plane defined by a stored normal, with optional plane retrieval and origin lookup.

results.name: unit_clear_weapon_change_flags
results.evidence: Calls FUN_00474db0 twice (a weapon/team related lookup), checks a global tag table (DAT_0087a480), conditionally calls FUN_00543dd0(1.0), then resets object fields at +800/+0x321/+0x348 and calls FUN_004726f0 -- the exact same tail sequence found (as a shared/folded fragment) in the tiny FUN_00565a70.
results.summary: Validates a weapon/label change and then clears the object's transient weapon-switch flags and timer.

results.name: unit_update
results.evidence: Existing name kept; the function body is exactly the tail of FUN_005659c0 (reset object+800/+0x321/+0x348, call FUN_004726f0, conditional FUN_00543dd0), so this address is most likely a compiler-folded shared tail rather than a distinct full unit-update routine -- the name is plausible for a transient-state reset but is not fully verifiable from this fragment alone.
results.summary: Shares its entire body with the tail of FUN_005659c0: clears transient weapon-switch object flags and timer fields.

results.name: unit_get_active_weapon_scale
results.evidence: If the unit's current-weapon slot (0x2f2/0x2f8, the pattern established across this file) is valid, returns FUN_004c2d70()'s float10 result, otherwise defaults to 1.0.
results.summary: Returns a scale/modifier value derived from the unit's currently held weapon, defaulting to 1.0 when unarmed.

results.name: unit_local_player_weapon_flag_check
results.evidence: Reads a fixed global record (DAT_0087a478, checked for type==1) to obtain an object index, validates it against the object table (DAT_0087a480), and if valid delegates to FUN_00565b60.
results.summary: Resolves a globally tracked object (likely the local player's unit) and forwards to a per-weapon flag test.

results.name: unit_current_weapon_has_flag
results.evidence: Looks up the given unit's current weapon (0x2f2/0x2f8 pattern) and tests bit 0x4000 of the dword at the weapon object's tag+0x308.
results.summary: Tests whether a unit's currently equipped weapon's type tag has a specific flag bit set.

results.name: unit_animation_state_is_compatible
results.evidence: Switches on a byte at (in_ECX)+0xb (a tag-side state/class byte) combined with a short in_DX, returning a compatibility bool; called from FUN_00566de0 and FUN_005674a0 while deciding whether to transition the unit's animation state.
results.summary: Tests whether a given animation-state/class combination is compatible, used to gate animation-state transitions.

results.name: unit_state_is_scripted_animation
results.evidence: Returns true only for a specific set of tag-class byte values (0x17-0x29 subset) at (in_ECX)+0xb -- the same value set repeatedly compared against unit+0x2a3 elsewhere in this file to detect uninterruptible/special-move animation states.
results.summary: Returns whether a given animation-state value belongs to the set of uninterruptible/special-move states.

results.name: unit_state_allows_control
results.evidence: Returns 0 for a broad subset of tag-class byte values at (in_ECX)+0xb overlapping heavily with unit_state_is_scripted_animation's set, and 1 otherwise -- an inverse-style gate.
results.summary: Returns whether a given animation state still permits normal unit control input.

results.name: unit_animation_state_from_seat_type
results.evidence: Maps a small enumerated short (in_CX, values 0-0xf/0x25/0x26) into one of two animation-state constants (0x19 or 0x1a, the same constants driven by unit+0x2a3 elsewhere), returning -1 for unmapped inputs.
results.summary: Maps a seat/action enum value into one of the unit's core animation-state constants.

results.name: unit_start_seat_overlay_animation_a
results.evidence: Given a unit and a small command enum (param_2, 1-9), looks up a marker/overlay index in the unit's weapon-permutation block (fields +0x98/0x9c or +0x30/0x34), allocates a new animation instance via FUN_004d6280(1), and writes it into unit+0x2aa/0x2ab/0x2a9; dispatched from FUN_00567400.
results.summary: Starts one of the unit's seat-control overlay animations, tracked at unit+0x2aa, for a given command value.

results.name: unit_try_set_animation_state
results.evidence: 22 callers; maps a small command enum (param_2, 0-0x2b) to an animation index in the unit-type's overlay table (via tag+0x40/0x44 and tag+0x98/0x9c), validates it exists, allocates a new permutation via FUN_004d6280(1), stores it at unit+0xcc/0xd0/0xd2, and finally writes param_2 into unit+0x2a3, the animation-state byte read/written throughout this file.
results.summary: Central routine that validates and applies a new animation-state value to a unit, allocating the underlying animation instance.

results.name: unit_start_seat_overlay_animation_b
results.evidence: Structurally identical to FUN_00565e00 but writes a second overlay slot (unit+0x2ae/0x2ac/0x2a5) and is gated on unit+0x2a5, dispatched from FUN_00567400 for a different set of command values.
results.summary: Starts the unit's second seat-control overlay animation, tracked at unit+0x2ae, for a given command value.

results.name: unit_find_best_seat_to_enter
results.evidence: Iterates a target vehicle's seats (loop bound at target-tag+0x2e4), computes the requesting unit's distance to each seat's entry/exit markers via FUN_005640a0, filters occupied seats using unit_set_or_test_seat_and_weapon_label and FUN_00566840, validates candidates with FUN_0042b810, and returns the best (nearest, unoccupied) seat index through the output parameter.
results.summary: Finds the nearest valid, unoccupied seat on a target vehicle for a unit to board.

results.name: unit_seat_is_occupied_by_other
results.evidence: Walks the linked list of units seated in param_2 (next-links at object+0x114/0x118) checking each occupant's state flags and seat index (0x2f0) against param_1, calling FUN_0045bd50 as an additional priority test when unit+0x218 is set; outputs the found occupant's index and returns whether the caller itself is not already the sole occupant.
results.summary: Checks whether a vehicle already has another occupant seated, and returns that occupant's index.

results.name: unit_all_seats_unoccupied
results.evidence: Loops over the unit-type's seat count (tag+0x2e4) calling FUN_0056cc10 per seat and returns false as soon as any seat reports a specific status (1), otherwise returns true once every seat has been checked.
results.summary: Returns whether none of a unit-type's seats currently report the tracked occupancy status.

results.name: unit_enter_vehicle_seat
results.evidence: On success (gated by FUN_00566840), sets unit+0xbc (current seat index) and unit+0x47 (parent vehicle object index), transforms the unit's position into the seat's local space via matrix4x3_inverse_transform_vector, applies the seat's weapon label via unit_set_or_test_seat_and_weapon_label, and calls object_recalculate_bounding_radius_recursive -- the canonical 'unit enters a vehicle seat' sequence.
results.summary: Places a unit into a specific seat of a target vehicle, updating its parent/seat linkage, transform, and weapon label.

results.name: unit_broadcast_state_change_event
results.evidence: Optionally resolves an index via the already-named hash_table_get, then packs it plus a fixed-size structure into a call to FUN_004ec940 and conditionally FUN_004e1a80(1,&DAT_00871de0,...) -- the shape of queuing a networked/event-system message.
results.summary: Queues a networked event/message carrying an optional hash-table-resolved index, used after seat-entry/exit transitions.

results.name: unit_apply_network_control_update
results.evidence: Branches on a packet-type dword at *in_EAX, and for type 0 unpacks a bit-packed structure via datum_get/object_try_and_get and applies it through FUN_00566de0 and FUN_00568cb0, otherwise delegates to FUN_004ec670 for other packet types.
results.summary: Applies an incoming (likely networked) control/state update to a unit, dispatching by packet type.

results.name: unit_update_stance_and_jump
results.evidence: References the string "stand" when forcing a unit into its standing seat via unit_set_or_test_seat_and_weapon_label; compares the unit's velocity fields (0x3a/0x3b) against tag-defined thresholds (tag+0x218/0x220/0x228) to decide jump-vs-land booleans, and finally writes the resulting value into unit+0x2a3 before invoking FUN_005704d0 with a footstep/impact category.
results.summary: Decides and applies a unit's stand/crouch/jump/land animation-state transition based on its current motion and grounded state.

results.name: unit_dispatch_seat_control_animation
results.evidence: Switches an incoming short (in_CX, 1-8) to call either FUN_00566410 or FUN_00565e00, matching the two seat-control overlay-animation starters identified in this file.
results.summary: Dispatches a seat-control command to the appropriate overlay-animation starter based on its enumerated value.

results.name: unit_apply_damage_response
results.evidence: Takes two float damage-magnitude parameters (param_4/param_5) and a responsible-object pointer (param_6); on sufficiently large damage it can eject the unit from its parent vehicle seat (clearing unit+0x47/0xc9/0xca, resetting seat 0xbc, setting animation-state 0x2a3=0x1b), computes an impact direction via vector2d_angle_between, and triggers physical-response effects through FUN_0042be40/FUN_0042b880.
results.summary: Applies the gameplay side effects of damage to a unit, including possible vehicle ejection, animation-state change, and impact-direction-based effects.

results.name: unit_exit_vehicle_seat
results.evidence: Validates a seat/marker record, forces the occupant to a standing pose via unit_update_stance_and_jump(unit,1), clears vehicle/weapon-related transient state via FUN_00568610(unit,0), and finally sends a networked event through unit_broadcast_state_change_event -- the mirror image of unit_enter_vehicle_seat.
results.summary: Removes a unit from its current vehicle seat, resetting its pose and transient state and broadcasting the change.

results.name: unit_record_recent_damage_location
results.evidence: Maintains a fixed 4-entry cache (unit+0x430..0x46c, each with a timestamp from DAT_006f1d6c+0xc) of recent hit locations/amounts (param_1, param_4, param_6), replacing the oldest/lowest-priority entry, and separately consults a per-object bitfield table (DAT_006b0b84) keyed by seat/param_5 to avoid repeats.
results.summary: Records a recent damage or contact event into a small per-unit cache, used to avoid repeating an associated response too often.

results.name: unit_get_cached_random_variant
results.evidence: Computed once and memoized via a bit in unit+0x81 (0x20000): advances the DAT_00719cd0 PRNG, derives a random index within a range from tag fields +0x25c/+0x25e, and calls FUN_00427280 only when that index is positive.
results.summary: Lazily computes and caches a random variant/permutation index for a unit, seeded from the global PRNG.

results.name: unit_reset_transient_state
results.evidence: Clears unit+0x108 (short), calls FUN_004f7450(1), releases held sound/loop handles at unit+0x86/0x7d/0x7e via FUN_00474e10/FUN_00428ab0/FUN_00428e50, stamps unit+0x107 from DAT_006f1d6c+0xc, and then (when the unit has a valid parent/seat) proceeds into additional seat/vehicle transition handling; structurally near-identical to FUN_00568cb0.
results.summary: Releases a unit's transient sound/animation handles and, when seated, performs additional vehicle-seat transition cleanup.

results.name: unit_exit_seat_cleanup
results.evidence: Shares FUN_00568610's initial cleanup of unit+0x86/0x7d/0x7e sound handles and unit+0x107 timestamp, but additionally calls FUN_0056dec0(param_1,1) (a 'clear seat' style call) and resets unit+0x2ae/0x2aa/0x289/0x28d overlay/weapon-switch fields, consistent with finalizing a seat-exit.
results.summary: Performs the transient-state cleanup used when a unit fully leaves its seat, also clearing its overlay-animation and weapon-switch fields.

results.name: unit_get_named_marker_position_a
results.evidence: Thin wrapper that calls FUN_004f6080() and copies its 3-float output (local_c/local_8/local_4) into *unaff_ESI[0..2]; references global DAT_0066bfa0, likely selecting a fixed marker-name string baked in at the call site.
results.summary: Retrieves the world position of a fixed named marker via FUN_004f6080 and returns it through the implicit ESI output pointer.

results.name: unit_get_camera_position
results.evidence: When not seated and not dead, interpolates a camera-height offset between tag fields +0x400 (stand) and +0x404 (crouch) using the unit's crouch-transition ratio at unit+0x143 (clamped between 0 and 1); when seated (unit+0x47 valid), instead reads the parent vehicle's marker-derived position fields (+0x17/0x18/0x19) -- the classic Blam stand/crouch/vehicle camera-position blend.
results.summary: Computes a unit's current camera position, blending between standing and crouching heights or using the vehicle seat's camera marker when mounted.

results.name: unit_compute_camera_relative_offset
results.evidence: Calls object_get_position or FUN_0055a170/FUN_00571de0 to obtain a reference point, then subtracts the unit's camera position (unit_get_camera_position) from a caller-supplied point and adds the difference into *in_EAX.
results.summary: Computes the offset between a given world point and the unit's camera position, accumulating it into an output vector.

results.name: unit_get_named_marker_position_b
results.evidence: Identical in structure to FUN_00568f50 (calls FUN_004f6080 then copies its 3-float output into *unaff_ESI), but references a different global (DAT_00672034), implying a different fixed marker-name string is used at this call site.
results.summary: Retrieves the world position of a second fixed named marker via FUN_004f6080 and returns it through the implicit ESI output pointer.

results.name: unit_animation_state_from_action
results.evidence: Switches a small enumerated short (in_CX, 0-0xd) into one of the animation-state constants used throughout this file (0x1b-0x29, 4-7, 0x28-0x29), and via the in_EDX output pointer additionally reports a priority/class value of 6 or 3 depending on the action.
results.summary: Maps a scripted/action command enum into the corresponding unit animation-state constant and its priority class.

results.name: unit_get_seat_control_availability
results.evidence: Short-circuits based on whether the unit's animation state (0x2a3) belongs to the uninterruptible-state set (matching unit_state_is_scripted_animation's set); otherwise, when the unit has a valid parent/seat, looks up a per-seat control byte (parent seat block +0x24, stride 0x11c) for a given control index (unaff_DI, range-checked to 0xb..0xe).
results.summary: Reports whether a specific seat control is currently available to the unit, depending on its animation state and seating.

results.name: unit_animation_set_state
results.evidence: Existing name kept; the function body is a single ret instruction (1 byte), so it cannot be verified functionally, but the plausible-sounding existing symbol name is retained since nothing in the (absent) body contradicts it.
results.summary: Effectively a no-op stub (single return instruction) under this name; no observable behavior to confirm or refute it.

results.name: unit_action_animation_exists
results.evidence: Calls unit_get_seat_control_availability to gate, then unit_animation_state_from_action to map an action to an animation index, and checks that index against the unit-type's overlay table bounds (tag+0x98/0x9c) before returning a bool.
results.summary: Checks whether the animation corresponding to a given scripted action currently exists for the unit's type.

results.name: unit_start_action_animation
results.evidence: Performs the same availability check as unit_action_animation_exists, but on success actually starts the animation: sets unit+0xcc/0xd0/0xd2 and a bit in unit+0xa6, writes unit+0x2a3 = 0x1d, and conditionally triggers an impact effect via FUN_005704d0 when grounded and unseated.
results.summary: Starts a unit's scripted action animation (e.g. melee/grenade-throw class) if one exists for the requested action.

results.name: unit_update_stub
results.evidence: Function body is a bare `return;` despite listing DAT_008603b0/DAT_0087bc14 as referenced globals, suggesting the real logic was inlined at call sites, leaving this address as a vestigial no-op with 3 callers.
results.summary: Currently a no-op; its referenced globals suggest it once performed unit/tag-table work that has since been inlined away.

results.name: unit_get_ground_normal
results.evidence: Trivial getter copying the 3 floats at unit+0x23c/0x240/0x244 into *in_EAX; the same fields are consumed by FUN_005658f0 as a plane normal for point-projection, consistent with a stored ground/surface normal.
results.summary: Returns the unit's stored ground/surface normal vector.

results.name: unit_get_attachment_relative_vector
results.evidence: When the object has no parent (object+0x11c == -1) returns its own vector at +0x74/0x78/0x7c directly; otherwise transforms that vector through the parent's skeleton node matrix (node index from parent-tag+0x1f2, node array at object+0x120*0x34) via matrix4x3_transform_normal -- the standard parent-relative-vector resolution pattern also seen in unit_get_camera_position.
results.summary: Returns a unit's stored direction/offset vector, transformed into world space through its parent object's skeleton node when attached.
